title: [GMCP 203.032.02] Production path: Transport, origin, SSRF, DNS, and endpoint security
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-032-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: Network policy validates every URL and redirect, resolves and pins permitted addresses, blocks private/link-local/metadata reachability unless explicitly granted, detects DNS rebinding, enforces host/origin/TLS and certificate rules, and separates proxy trust zones. Localhost impersonation, rebinding, redirect chains, request smuggling, header confusion, downgrade and egress-bypass suites fail closed. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
